user.title: Find a bus stop
user.description: Select a bus stop in KakaoMap, copy its share link, and paste it below.

data_description.stop_id: Enter a KakaoMap link (map.kakao.com or kko.to), or a stop ID beginning with BS.

select_bus.title: Choose buses

data_description.buses: Choose at least one bus to show its arrivals.
data_description.stop_nickname: For example, Morning commute. Leave blank to use the original stop name.

polling.name: Polling
polling.description: Adaptive polling checks every 30 seconds when a selected route arrives within three minutes. Otherwise it checks every 120 seconds. Fixed polling keeps the selected interval.

data_description.scan_interval: Used only with fixed polling. Choose a whole number from 30 to 600 seconds.

pause.name: Optional pause schedule
pause.description: The default pause is daily from 00:00 to 05:00 in the Home Assistant time zone.

reconfigure.title: Refresh stop details
reconfigure.description:
Refresh the name, direction, and available route list for **{stop_name}**. This refreshes this same stop only and keeps its entity IDs and selected routes.

[View this stop in KakaoMap]({map_url})

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to KakaoMap. Check your connection and try again. Your input has been kept.
error.invalid_stop_id: Stop not found. Enter a KakaoMap bus-stop share link or an ID beginning with BS.
error.invalid_response: Could not read KakaoMap's response. Try again later.
error.rate_limited: KakaoMap is temporarily limiting requests. Try again later.
error.no_buses_found: No routes are available at this stop. Check the stop and direction, or try again later.
error.ambiguous_routes_only: All route names returned for this stop are ambiguous. Wait for KakaoMap to provide distinct route names, then try again.
error.invalid_bus: Choose a bus from the list.

abort.already_configured: This stop is already configured. Change its buses in the existing integration options.

init.title: Buses and updates
init.description:
**{stop_name}**

[View this stop in KakaoMap]({map_url})

Pause times use your Home Assistant time zone ({timezone}).

data_description.buses: Existing selections remain available during an outage. Deselect all to stop displaying arrivals for this stop.
data_description.stop_nickname: Leave blank to use the original stop name. A manually renamed device keeps its name.

polling.name: Polling
polling.description: Adaptive polling checks every 30 seconds when a selected route arrives within three minutes. Otherwise it checks every 120 seconds. Fixed polling keeps the selected interval.

data_description.scan_interval: Used only with fixed polling. Choose a whole number from 30 to 600 seconds.

pause.name: Pause updates
pause.description: When enabled, updates pause daily between these times, for example 00:00–05:00. Arrival values are cleared and the paused status is shown.

data_description.quiet_enabled: Turn off for updates throughout the day.
data_description.quiet_end: Updates resume at this time. The schedule can cross midnight.

error.route_list_unavailable: The latest route list is unavailable. You can still edit existing selections and times. Reopen options after connectivity returns to add other routes.
error.invalid_time: Enter valid start and end times.
error.equal_pause_times: Choose different start and end times, or turn off scheduled pauses for all-day updates.
error.invalid_interval: Enter a whole number from 30 to 600 seconds.
error.invalid_bus: Choose a bus from the list.
